Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 5, "heading": "CHAPTER III", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u005-r0094", "target": "В этот миг вернулся мальчик-индеец, бегом принесший её купальный халат; она выхватила его и поспешно накинула. Затем с помощью мальчика снова взялась за узел. Когда платок наконец упал, она отшвырнула его, словно и впрямь это была гадюка.", "source_sha256": "c6569345206137fd7bd4f8cfe3174e344fb74690f7d0800316edb4f5b743d430", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u005-r0094", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c982d4c1a4c98afb06d6d13e8580e433dcdc4844e25b6d8ae65055e3be372d8c"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u005-r0095", "target": "— Это была скверна, — бросила она, чтобы он слышал.", "source_sha256": "e09724c06564bcd7a14dca4f66e4802ac554181e90db74b48c501d102170a169", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u005-r0095", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e2938405869fe5f149df48c1a8aa4ebec762d4d9f9b6cb5d4329806affa3cf03"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u005-r0096", "tag": "p", "text": "But Francis, still engaged in hardening his heart against her, shook his head slowly and said:", "sha256": "7089ad898650bafef34779bc968a9d468666a6d065f9f545468f38957ffc2265", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[324]", "source_html": "

But Francis, still engaged in hardening his heart against her, shook his head slowly and said:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0097", "tag": "p", "text": "“It doesn’t save you, Leoncia. I’ve left my mark on you that never will come off.”", "sha256": "0349b63cea2de2782ab6a1d00db90b89160b5d98311310ac55e84505c2083996", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[325]", "source_html": "

“It doesn’t save you, Leoncia. I’ve left my mark on you that never will come off.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0098", "tag": "p", "text": "He pointed to the excoriations he had made on her knee and laughed.", "sha256": "4de0aefaa9fcdb7f4632073a966b1760b69355961efec967a7d95428bd6c0808", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[326]", "source_html": "

He pointed to the excoriations he had made on her knee and laughed.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0099", "tag": "p", "text": "“The mark of the beast,” she came back, turning to go. “I warn you to take yourself off, Mr. Henry Morgan.”", "sha256": "c8eed8dc9742ea0159b51569f3f0d13b8fa1a45ced436e08d9e6d1ec82302bf8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[327]", "source_html": "

“The mark of the beast,” she came back, turning to go. “I warn you to take yourself off, Mr. Henry Morgan.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0100", "tag": "p", "text": "But he stepped in her way.", "sha256": "7b50826a626193a9fd68505b9d46dc30969da5626a474d27eea86731e23f39c6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[328]", "source_html": "

But he stepped in her way.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0101", "tag": "p", "text": "“And now we’ll talk business, Miss Solano,” he said in changed tones. “And you will listen. Let your eyes flash all they please, but don’t interrupt me.” He stooped and picked up the note he had been engaged in writing. “I was just sending that to you by the boy when you screamed. Take it. Read it. It won’t bite you. It isn’t a viperine.”", "sha256": "583064106f00432f10bef4006fbed43a06e398378c21b4027fa8c20b89fd6939", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[329]", "source_html": "

“And now we’ll talk business, Miss Solano,” he said in changed tones. “And you will listen. Let your eyes flash all they please, but don’t interrupt me.” He stooped and picked up the note he had been engaged in writing. “I was just sending that to you by the boy when you screamed. Take it. Read it. It won’t bite you. It isn’t a viperine.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0102", "tag": "p", "text": "Though she refused to receive it, her eyes involuntarily scanned the opening line:", "sha256": "f7e4c3d1310aec0e1b64ffc5d64d7c164c56d1ce04ce7e2113479adb67670f03", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[330]", "source_html": "

Though she refused to receive it, her eyes involuntarily scanned the opening line:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0103", "tag": "p", "text": "[[I]]I am the man whom you mistook for Henry Morgan[[/I]]...", "sha256": "3c9ab6be20a698b9231b88ff090aeb7776fdcf41b2156c93ae598c36e6c7ec47", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[331]", "source_html": "

I am the man whom you mistook for Henry Morgan...

", "emphasis_spans": 1}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0104", "tag": "p", "text": "She looked at him with startled eyes that could not comprehend much but which were guessing many vague things.", "sha256": "20a8417ea667880406030566f658d966c353472d6a36ed2e206b8335a02bb328", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[332]", "source_html": "

She looked at him with startled eyes that could not comprehend 34much but which were guessing many vague things.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0105", "tag": "p", "text": "“On my honor,” he said gravely.", "sha256": "0f3faa81a52fb47dfcbb4061cb76d623b1ef9bccc27c32663b5e09da438b40cf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[333]", "source_html": "

“On my honor,” he said gravely.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0106", "tag": "p", "text": "“You ... are ... not ... Henry?” she gasped.", "sha256": "3226b9a027b5f4d3d55382746f417dc593380196dad2aa5980aac03e4c3eea7e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[334]", "source_html": "

“You ... are ... not ... Henry?” she gasped.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0107", "tag": "p", "text": "“No, I am not. Won’t you please take it and read.”", "sha256": "a9b9eff48d702cda5ff6400f8b9896d7f9e79f069f856f8ac98bcda63db5d111", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[335]", "source_html": "

“No, I am not. Won’t you please take it and read.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0108", "tag": "p", "text": "This time she complied, while he gazed with all his eyes upon the golden pallor of the sun on her tropic-touched blonde face which colored the blood beneath, or which was touched by the blood beneath, to the amazingly beautiful golden pallor.", "sha256": "0208b05cda0c03d010a1ba5877be7f5e09f1c0979c39804494ca1a63e1c9ecfb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[336]", "source_html": "

This time she complied, while he gazed with all his eyes upon the golden pallor of the sun on her tropic-touched blonde face which colored the blood beneath, or which was touched by the blood beneath, to the amazingly beautiful golden pallor.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0109", "tag": "p", "text": "Almost in a dream he discovered himself looking into her startled, questioning eyes of velvet brown.", "sha256": "e4c81a3a09e47f52fe58819d81e36404cad63eb86a1d60e28c9b4eca627a66b8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[337]", "source_html": "

Almost in a dream he discovered himself looking into her startled, questioning eyes of velvet brown.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0110", "tag": "p", "text": "“And who should have signed this?” she repeated.", "sha256": "0586c04c42e78b43a0e8c4ff0abc40a35f4a2778c28f8c88c97e7cd907246ffb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[338]", "source_html": "

“And who should have signed this?” she repeated.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0111", "tag": "p", "text": "He came to himself and bowed.", "sha256": "f3dac20706fe2be154ff9f4e948d34d18676b487217f7836390cafa0a4bebbe2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[339]", "source_html": "

He came to himself and bowed.
